raw.details:
Db2Hack 2026 

Organised by: IBM Db2 TechX
In Association With: IBM, Institution's Innovation Council (IIC), GL Bajaj Group of Institutions, Mathura, and NexaSphere
Opportunity Mode: Online
Participation Mode: Individual (Solo Only)
Registration Fee: Free
Final Submission Deadline: 10 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST
Results Announcement: 11 November 2026

About Db2Hack 2026

Ready to build something meaningful with AI and enterprise databases?

Db2Hack 2026 is an online hackathon that challenges students, developers, and AI enthusiasts to build practical AI-powered applications using IBM Db2.

Participants will explore how enterprise databases can power modern AI applications by combining IBM Db2 with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, CrewAI, and Langflow.

You can build solutions involving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent AI agents, vector search, document intelligence, text-to-SQL, and AI-powered analytics.

No prior IBM Db2 experience is required. Whether you are exploring AI for the first time or already building intelligent applications, this is an opportunity to learn, experiment, and demonstrate your skills through a working project.

The goal is simple: Build. Innovate. Submit. Make your AI idea work with IBM Db2.

Challenge Tracks and Technologies

Participants must integrate IBM Db2 into their solution and use at least ONE of the following supported AI frameworks:

  • LangChain

  • LlamaIndex

  • Haystack

  • CrewAI

  • Langflow

You may combine multiple frameworks when required by your project architecture.

Suggested Project Directions

  • AI-powered RAG applications

  • Intelligent AI agents and agentic workflows

  • Database-powered conversational applications

  • Semantic search and vector search

  • Natural Language to SQL (Text-to-SQL)

  • Document intelligence and information extraction

  • AI-powered data analytics

These are suggested directions, not restrictions. Participants are encouraged to identify real-world problems and develop original, practical solutions.

Eligibility Criteria

Db2Hack 2026 is open to:

  • Students from any college or university.

  • Software developers and fresh graduates.

  • Working professionals.

  • AI, machine learning, and technology enthusiasts.

Participation is strictly individual. Each participant must register and submit their own project. Team submissions are not permitted.

Registration is free, and prior experience with IBM Db2 is not mandatory.

Participation Process

Follow these steps to participate:

  1. Register: Complete your registration on Unstop and register through the official Luma event page by 8 November 2026.

  2. Join the Community: Join the official WhatsApp community. This is mandatory for receiving announcements, workshop updates, technical resources, and submission instructions.

  3. Set Up Your Environment: Install the IBM Db2 Developer Extension for VS Code and set up IBM Db2 Community Edition.

  4. Build Your Project: Develop an AI-powered application using IBM Db2 and at least one supported AI framework.

  5. Submit Your Work: Complete both the GitHub Pull Request and Google Form submission before the final deadline.

Hackathon Rounds

Round 1: Ideation & Architecture

Participants propose an innovative project using IBM Db2 and Agentic AI. The proposal should identify a real-world problem, explain the proposed solution, and describe the intended technical approach.

Proposal submission should include:

  • Project title and problem statement.

  • Proposed solution and key features.

  • Selected Agentic AI framework.

  • IBM Db2 connector and intended integration.

  • Proposed system architecture and workflow.

  • Expected impact and use case.

Participants must upload their proposal as a PDF or PPT through the designated submission field.

Round 2: Build & Final Submission

Participants develop a functional implementation of their proposed solution, demonstrating meaningful IBM Db2 integration with their selected AI framework.

Final submission must include:

  • Working project and complete source code.

  • Project documentation, including setup and execution instructions.

  • System architecture and implementation details.

  • Screenshots demonstrating the application.

  • A demo video showcasing the working solution.

GitHub Submission: Participants must fork the official repository, follow its submission template, add their project, and raise a Pull Request (PR) against the original repository.

Google Form: Participants must submit their GitHub PR link through the official Google Form.

Both the GitHub PR and Google Form submission are mandatory.

Submission Guidelines

All participants must complete the following requirements:

  1. Submit the project through a Pull Request to the official GitHub repository.

  2. Follow the repository's submission template and documentation guidelines.

  3. Include working source code, setup instructions, and project documentation.

  4. Submit the GitHub PR URL through the official Google Form.

  5. Share the project use case on LinkedIn and tag the organising team.

Final Submission Deadline: 10 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST.

Incomplete submissions or submissions received after the deadline may not qualify for evaluation.

Evaluation Criteria

Projects will be evaluated based on the following criteria:

  • IBM Db2 Integration & Depth (30%): Meaningful use of IBM Db2, including database connectivity, data operations, and relevant capabilities.

  • Innovation & Impact (25%): Originality, problem relevance, practical usefulness, and potential impact.

  • Technical Architecture & AI Integration (20%): Quality of system architecture and effective use of the selected AI framework.

  • Reproducibility & Code Quality (15%): Code organisation, implementation quality, and ease of setup and execution.

  • Documentation & Presentation (10%): Clarity of project documentation and demonstration.

Rewards and Recognition

Top 3 Participants

  • Trophy

  • IBM Db2 Kit

  • Certificate of Excellence

Top 10 Participants

  • IBM Db2 Goodies

  • Certificate of Merit

Projects with High Potential

Selected projects with strong potential may receive an opportunity to contribute their use cases to the IBM Db2 GitHub Organisation.

All participants get an opportunity to showcase their technical skills through a practical project built on an enterprise database.

Workshops and Technical Support

The on-campus IBM Db2 TechX Summit and hands-on workshop at GL Bajaj, Mathura, took place on 30 October 2026.

Additional online support will include:

  • Live online technical workshop.

  • Online doubt-solving session.

  • Guidance on IBM Db2 setup and configuration.

  • Assistance with AI frameworks and project integration.

  • Guidance on GitHub submissions and documentation.

Dates and joining details for upcoming online sessions will be announced through the official WhatsApp community.

Important Dates

Event Date
Hackathon Begins 28 October 2026
On-campus Db2 TechX Summit 30 October 2026
Luma Registration Deadline 8 November 2026
Final Project Submission 10 November 2026, 5:00 PM IST
Results Announcement 11 November 2026

All deadlines follow Indian Standard Time (IST).

Important Instructions

  • Participation is strictly individual. Team submissions are not allowed.

  • Registration is free.

  • Unstop and Luma registration must be completed.

  • Joining the official WhatsApp community is mandatory.

  • Every project must use IBM Db2 and at least one supported AI framework.

  • Both GitHub PR and Google Form submissions are compulsory.

  • Follow the official GitHub repository template and submission guidelines.

  • Do not include passwords, API keys, or other sensitive credentials in your public repository.

  • Late or incomplete submissions may be disqualified.

Official Resources

Event Website: https://ibmdb2techxsummit.glbajajgroup.ac.in/

Unstop Registration: Available through the official event listing.

Luma Registration: https://luma.com/68jmineh

WhatsApp Community: https://chat.whatsapp.com/L5EwLpFMmqa179MsOgi9fu

GitHub Submission Repository: https://github.com/KunalGolaIBM/IBM_Db2_TechX_Project_Submission

Final Submission Google Form: https://forms.gle/n8GQL4tg7Yzftwu39

Learning Resources and Tutorials: Available on the official event website.

Ready to Build?

Turn your ideas into working AI applications. Explore enterprise database capabilities, experiment with modern AI frameworks, and build something that solves a real-world problem.

Build. Innovate. Submit.

See you at Db2Hack 2026!
